north_star: Surfari safely resumes account-sensitive Apple Developer workflows by passing increasingly realistic governance matrices while reducing humans to front-loaded policy approvals and explicit identity/legal/payment/release gates.

stages.name: Repo and Build Matrix
stages.unlock_next_when: All required rows pass, except package-manager or release-tooling rows may be blocked with owner and unblock command.

stages.name: Governance Logic Matrix
stages.unlock_next_when: All human-gate, expected-domain, partial-context, and protected-action rows pass with deterministic assertions.
stop_conditions: protected action allowed on human gate

stages.name: Daemon and Logs Matrix
stages.unlock_next_when: Rows prove prelaunch blocking, lifecycle logging, redaction, and safe learning-candidate shape.

stages.name: Fake Browser Workflow Matrix
stages.unlock_next_when: Fake redirect, stale ref, tab drift, prompt injection, download handoff, and wrapper smoke rows pass.

stages.name: Real Knox Apple Dry Run Matrix
stages.unlock_next_when: Real read-only and human-gate rows pass or are blocked with explicit human gate owner; no forbidden action occurs.
